editorial:
Imagine you are the leader of a whole country, but your time in office is almost up and you feel like you are falling apart. You get to see this stress through Mariano, the President of Italy, who is stuck between doing what is right for the people and what is right for his own heart. The movie feels like a slow walk through a beautiful house where everything looks perfect on the outside, but there are secrets hiding in every room. You will spend a lot of time watching the bond between Mariano and his daughter, Dorotea, who is the only person he can actually trust when things get messy.

The acting is top-notch and makes you feel every bit of the pressure the characters are under. While the story moves a bit slow at times, the emotional payoff is totally worth it. You should definitely watch this if you like stories about family and power. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the stunning Italian scenery. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move because the colors are just incredible.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mariano decides to step down from power early instead of fighting to stay. He chooses his relationship with Dorotea over his political legacy. The big twist is that he reveals a secret mistake from his past to the public, which clears his conscience but ruins his reputation. He ends up finding peace as a regular citizen, finally free from the weight of the crown and the lies he had to tell.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartfelt stories about family and politics.
